svg.title: 64-day heuristic: sugar, viable LAB and pH during spontaneous lacto-fermentation
svg.desc: Assumes 2% salt by food weight, a vacuum bag, 20–22 degrees Celsius throughout and no starter. Sugar: percent of day-zero amount, 20+80*exp(-t/8). Viable LAB: percent of modeled peak, 100*10^g(t); g=-5*(1-t/5)^2 until day 5, then -2*(t-5)/59. pH: right axis from 3 to 7, 3.5+2.1*exp(-t/2.5)+0.4*exp(-t/21). Daily ticks from 0 to 64. These independent illustrative curves are not a pooled experimental average, a probiotic benefit score, a measured batch pH or an established optimum. Long-term LAB decline is particularly uncertain. Sources: doi:10.1128/AEM.69.6.3192-3202.2003; doi:10.1128/spectrum.00168-22; doi:10.1556/446.2023.00080; doi:10.17306/J.AFS.001321; doi:10.2478/aucft-2024-0012; doi:10.4236/fns.2013.411A007.
svg.text: 2% salt / 20–22°C / vacuum bag / no starter / heuristic estimates
